brief:
Islamic and Arab institutions, led by the Union of Organizations Working for Jerusalem and Al-Aqsa Mosque, have called for marking the coming Friday, October 2, 2026, as "Great Dawn Friday" in support of Al-Aqsa Mosque, Shehab Wire reported. The organizations are urging the organization of public events and activities for the occasion.

No further details about the planned activities or the specific circumstances prompting the call were provided in the statement.
